FEMALE_DIRECTORS_PCT.name: Female Directors Percentage
FEMALE_DIRECTORS_PCT.description: The percentage of board members who are female. For companies with a two-tier board, the calculation is based on members of the Supervisory Board only.
FEMALE_DIRECTORS_PCT.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CARBON_EMISSIONS_EVIC_SCOPE_12_INTEN.name: Carbon emissions - Scope 1+2 EVIC intensity (tVO2e/USD million)
CARBON_EMISSIONS_EVIC_SCOPE_12_INTEN.description: Reported or estimated Scope 1+2 greenhouse gas emissions (expressed in tCO2e) normalized by enterprise value including cash (USD million). This ratio facilitates portfolio analysis by allocating emissions across equity and debt.
CARBON_EMISSIONS_EVIC_SCOPE_12_INTEN.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CARBON_EMISSIONS_SCOPE_12_INTEN.name: Carbon emissions - Scope 1+2 revenue intensity (tCO2e/USD million)
CARBON_EMISSIONS_SCOPE_12_INTEN.description: Reported or estimated Scope 1+2 greenhouse gas emissions (expressed in tCO2e) normalized by company sales (USD million). This ratio facilitates comparison between companies of different sizes.
CARBON_EMISSIONS_SCOPE_12_INTEN.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET.name: Company has Science-Based approved Emission Target (SBTI)
HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET.description: Flagged as "T" if the company has one or more active carbon emissions reduction target/s approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).
HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

HUMAN_CAPITAL_DEV_MGMT_SCORE.name: Human Capital Development Management Score
HUMAN_CAPITAL_DEV_MGMT_SCORE.description: Management indicators measure how well a company manages ESG risk and opportunities. These metrics are grouped into the following broad categories: Strategies & Policies, Targets & Implementation, and Demonstrated Performance. Higher scores on management indicate greater capacity to manage risk. See the IVA Methodology for details. (Score: 0-10)
HUMAN_CAPITAL_DEV_MGMT_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

PAY_CONTROVERSY.name: Pay Controversy
PAY_CONTROVERSY.description: Have the company’s pay policies or practices attracted adverse public comment from stakeholders (including shareholders, government, regulators etc)? Flagged if yes. The duration of the flag is dependent on the severity assessment.
PAY_CONTROVERSY.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

IVA_COMPANY_RATING.name: ESG Rating
IVA_COMPANY_RATING.description: A company’s final ESG Rating. To arrive at a final letter rating, the weighted average of the key issue scores are aggregated and companies are ranked from best (AAA) to worst (CCC).
IVA_COMPANY_RATING.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

IVA_RATING_DATE.name: ESG Rating Date
IVA_RATING_DATE.description: Date of which the ESG Rating was published.
IVA_RATING_DATE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

IVA_RATING_TREND.name: ESG Rating Trend
IVA_RATING_TREND.description: The ESG Rating Trend indicates the rating change from previous to current in terms of the number of rating notches downgraded or upgraded. For example; +3 = three notch upgrade, -2 = two notch downgrade, 0 = maintain, and blank = new rating.
IVA_RATING_TREND.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

INDUSTRY_ADJUSTED_SCORE.name: Final Industry-Adjusted Company Score
INDUSTRY_ADJUSTED_SCORE.description: The score is calculated by normalizing the Weighted Average Key Issue Score to the Industry peer set, adjusted to reflect any Ratings Review Committee overrides; see the ESG Rating Methodology document for details.
INDUSTRY_ADJUSTED_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_SCORE.name: Environmental Pillar Score
ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_SCORE.description: The Environmental Pillar Score represents the weighted average of all Key Issues that fall under the Environment Pillar.
ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.name: Environmental Pillar Weight
ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.description: The Environmental Pillar Weight represents the sum of the weights of all Key Issues that fall under the Environment Pillar.
ENVIRONMENTAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_SCORE.name: Governance Pillar Score
GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_SCORE.description: The Governance Pillar Score provides an assessment of risk and management practices related to Corporate Governance and Corporate Behavior. The 0-10 score is based on the sum of deductions derived from Key Metrics included in the Corporate Governance (including Board, Pay, Ownership & Control, and Accounting) and Corporate Behavior (including Business Ethics and Tax Transparency) themes. Low score
GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_WEIGHT.name: Governance Pillar Weight
GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_WEIGHT.description: The Governance Pillar Weight represents the sum of the weights of all Key Issues that fall under the Governance Pillar.
GOVERNANCE_PILLAR_WEIGHT.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

SOCIAL_PILLAR_SCORE.name: Social Pillar Score
SOCIAL_PILLAR_SCORE.description: The Social Pillar Score represents the weighted average of all Key Issues that fall under the Social Pillar.
SOCIAL_PILLAR_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

SOCIAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.name: Social Pillar Weight
SOCIAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.description: The Social Pillar Weight represents the sum of the weights of all Key Issues that fall under the Social Pillar.
SOCIAL_PILLAR_WEIGHT.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

OWNERSHIP_AND_CONTROL_SCORE.name: Ownership & Control 0-10 Score
OWNERSHIP_AND_CONTROL_SCORE.description: This is an absolute score for Ownership and Control, one of the four sub-themes used in our corporate governance scoring model. The scale is 0 (worst) to 10 (best).
OWNERSHIP_AND_CONTROL_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CONTR_CONTROVERSIAL_WORKPLACE_M.name: Controversial Workplace Accidents Controversies (Yes, No)
CONTR_CONTROVERSIAL_WORKPLACE_M.description: Flagged as "Yes" if company has faced significant recent controversy or criticism regarding employee health & safety.
CONTR_CONTROVERSIAL_WORKPLACE_M.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CBN_RENEW_ENER_USE_M.name: Uses energy from renewable sources (Yes, No)
CBN_RENEW_ENER_USE_M.description: Flagged as "Yes" if company uses energy from renewable sources.
CBN_RENEW_ENER_USE_M.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_NM.name: Three-year trend of average carbon emissions intensity (-1, 0, 1)
CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_NM.description: Flagged as "1" if the company's three-year average carbon emissions intensity is reducing at a rate of 5%. Flagged as "0" if trend is stable at a rate between -5% and 5% or if carbon emissions are estimated or does not have multi-year time series data. Flagged as "-1" if the carbon emissions intensity trend is increasing at a rate 5% or worst.
CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_NM.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CONTR_HEALTH_SAFETY_M.name: Health & Safety Controversies (Yes, No)
CONTR_HEALTH_SAFETY_M.description: Flagged as "Yes" if company has faced significant recent controversy or criticism regarding working conditions in its core operations.
CONTR_HEALTH_SAFETY_M.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

DIVERSITY_PROGRAMS_M.name: Programs to facilitate workforce diversity (Yes, No)
DIVERSITY_PROGRAMS_M.description: Flagged as "Yes" if company has programs to facilitate workforce diversity (gender, religion, ethnic background, etc.).
DIVERSITY_PROGRAMS_M.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

CONTR_BRIB_CORRUPT_N_SEVERE.name: Number of Severe and Very Severe Bribery and Corruption  Controversies
CONTR_BRIB_CORRUPT_N_SEVERE.description: Number of Severe and Very Severe controversy cases in the last three years related to: Bribery & corruption issues.
CONTR_BRIB_CORRUPT_N_SEVERE.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

BOARD_INDEP_OTHER_INTERESTS_PCT.name: Board Independent of Other Interests Percentage
BOARD_INDEP_OTHER_INTERESTS_PCT.description: The percentage of board members that meets our independent of other interests criteria (e.g., Significant Owners, Government, Employees), as defined by MSCI ESG Research.
BOARD_INDEP_OTHER_INTERESTS_PCT.product: MSCI ESG Ratings for Global Equities

UNGC_COMPLIANCE.name: Global Compact Compliance
UNGC_COMPLIANCE.description: This factor indicates whether the company is in compliance with the United Nations Global Compact principles. The possible values are Fail, Watch List, or Pass. See the ESG Controversies and Global Norms methodology document for detailed explanations.
UNGC_COMPLIANCE.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

OVERALL_FLAG.name: Company Summary - Overall Flag
OVERALL_FLAG.description: The overall company assessment signals whether a company has a notable controversy related to a company’s operations and/or products, and the severity of the social or environmental impact of the controversy.
OVERALL_FLAG.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

LABOR_RIGHTS_EMP_HS_FLAG.name: Labor Rights - Employee Health & Safety Flag
LABOR_RIGHTS_EMP_HS_FLAG.description: This indicator measures the severity of controversies related to the safety of a firm’s employees. Factors affecting this evaluation include, but are not limited to, a history of involvement in workplace safety-related legal cases, widespread or egregious fines for unsafe workplace practices, resistance to improved practices, and criticism by NGOs and/or other third-party observers.
LABOR_RIGHTS_EMP_HS_FLAG.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

LABOR_RIGHTS_DIVERSITY_FLAG.name: Labor Rights - Discrimination & Workforce Diversity Flag
LABOR_RIGHTS_DIVERSITY_FLAG.description: This indicator measures the severity of controversies related to a firm’s workforce diversity. Factors affecting this evaluation include, but are not limited to, a history of involvement in discrimination-related legal cases, widespread or egregious instances of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, or ethnicity, resistance to improved practices, and criticism by NGOs and/or other third-party
LABOR_RIGHTS_DIVERSITY_FLAG.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

LABOR_RIGHTS_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.name: Labor Rights - Controversy Flag
LABOR_RIGHTS_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.description: This ESG pillar is an assessment of controversies (if any) related to a firm’s employee relations and supply chain. Factors affecting this evaluation include whether a company is involved in controversies related to labor-management relations, employee health & safety, collective bargaining & unions, discrimination and workforce diversity, and management of supply chain employee relations standard
LABOR_RIGHTS_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_SCORE.name: Environment - Controversy Score
ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_SCORE.description: This ESG pillar is an assessment of controversies (if any) related to a firm’s impact on the environment. Factors affecting this evaluation include whether a company is involved in controversies related to land use and biodiversity, toxic spills and releases, energy and climate change, water management, operational non-hazardous waste, and management of supply chain environmental impact.
ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_SCORE.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.name: Environment - Controversy Flag
ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.description: This ESG pillar is an assessment of controversies (if any) related to a firm’s impact on the environment. Factors affecting this evaluation include whether a company is involved in controversies related to land use and biodiversity, toxic spills and releases, energy and climate change, water management, operational non-hazardous waste, environmental impact of products and service, and management o
ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_FLAG.product: MSCI ESG Controversies and Global Norms Screening

ISSUER_CNTRY_DOMICILE.name: Issuer Country of Domicile
ISSUER_CNTRY_DOMICILE.description: Issuer Country of Domicile. System factor
ISSUER_CNTRY_DOMICILE.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

SI_TOTAL_MAX_REV.name: Social Impact Solutions - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
SI_TOTAL_MAX_REV.description: This field represents the total of all revenues derived from any of the seven social impact themes including nutrition, sanitation, major diseases treatment, SME finance, education, affordable real estate or connectivity.
SI_TOTAL_MAX_REV.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

SI_SUST_IMPACT_MAX_REV.name: Sustainable Impact Solutions - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
SI_SUST_IMPACT_MAX_REV.description: This field represents the total of all revenues derived from any of the thirteeen social and environmental impact themes including nutrition, sanitation, major diseases treatment, SME finance, education or affordable real estate, alternative energy, energy efficiency, green building, pollution prevention and sustainable water. Overlapping scores may occur in certain themes.
SI_SUST_IMPACT_MAX_REV.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

CT_ALT_ENERGY_MAX_REV.name: Alternative Energy - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
CT_ALT_ENERGY_MAX_REV.description: The recent-year percentage of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from products, services, or infrastructure projects supporting the development or delivery of renewable energy and alternative fuels.
CT_ALT_ENERGY_MAX_REV.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

CT_ENERGY_EFF_MAX_REV.name: Energy Efficiency - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
CT_ENERGY_EFF_MAX_REV.description: The recent-year percentage of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from products, services, infrastructure, or technologies that proactively address the growing global demand for energy while minimizing impacts to the environment.
CT_ENERGY_EFF_MAX_REV.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

CT_TOTAL_MAX_REV.name: Environmental Impact Solutions - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
CT_TOTAL_MAX_REV.description: This field represents the total of all revenues derived from any of the six environmental impact themes including alternative energy, energy efficiency, green building, pollution prevention, sustainable water, or sustainable agriculture.
CT_TOTAL_MAX_REV.product: MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics and SDG Alignment

CWEAP_TIE.name: Controversial Weapons - Any Tie
CWEAP_TIE.description: Companies that have any ties to cluster munitions, landmines, biological / chemical weapons, depleted uranium weapons, blinding laser weapons, incendiary weapons, and/or non-detectable fragments.

EST_EU_TAXONOMY_MAX_REV.name: Estimated EU Taxonomy Alignment - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
EST_EU_TAXONOMY_MAX_REV.description: Estimated EU Taxonomy Alignment - Maximum Percentage of Revenue indicates a company’s estimated maximum percent of revenue from products and services addressing environmental objectives, based on the MSCI Sustainable Impact Metrics framework. Companies with Red and Orange Flag environmental controversies, and Red Flag social and governance controversies are excluded from the list as failing to mee

TOB_DIST_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Tobacco Distributor - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
TOB_DIST_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from the distribution of tobacco products.

TOB_RET_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Tobacco Retailer - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
TOB_RET_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from retail sales of tobacco products.

TOB_SUPP_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Tobacco Supplier - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
TOB_SUPP_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from supplying products essential to the tobacco industry.

TRIR.name: Total Recordable Incident Rate
TRIR.description: Total recordable incident rate (TRIR) per million hours worked. The TRIR includes fatalities, lost time injuries, restricted work injuries and medical treatment injuries

CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN.name: Policy on anti-corruption and anti-bribery (UN Convention against Corruption)
CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN.description: Company has an anti-corruption and anti-bribery policy consistent with the United Nations Convention against Corruption.

GENDER_PAY_GAP_RATIO.name: Gender pay gap ratio
GENDER_PAY_GAP_RATIO.description: The difference between the average gross hourly earnings of male and female employees as a percentage of male gross earnings. Note that reporting on this metric is inconsistent: some companies report on the absolute or uncontrolled pay gap while others control for compensable factors such as role or location.

ACTIVE_FF_SECTOR_EXPOSURE.name: Active Fossil Fuel Sector Exposure
ACTIVE_FF_SECTOR_EXPOSURE.description: Company’s exposure to fossil fuels related activities, including extraction, processing, storage and transportation of petroleum products, natural gas, and thermal and metallurgical coal.

CONTRO_WEAP_CBLMBW_ANYTIE.name: Exposure to controversial weapons (landmines, cluster munitions, chemical weapons and biological weapons)
CONTRO_WEAP_CBLMBW_ANYTIE.description: Company has an industry tie to landmines, cluster munitions, chemical weapons or biological weapons. Note: industry tie includes ownership, manufacture or investment. Landmines do not include related safety products.

MECH_UN_GLOBAL_COMPACT.name: Mechanism to monitor compliance with UN Global Compact
MECH_UN_GLOBAL_COMPACT.description: The company is a signatory to the UN Global Compact and is required to monitor and report compliance with the UN Global Compact principles.

PCT_NONRENEW_CONSUMP_PROD.name: Percentage of non-renewable energy consumption and production
PCT_NONRENEW_CONSUMP_PROD.description: The company's energy consumption and/or production from non-renewable sources as a percentage of total energy use and/or generation

OPS_PROT_BIODIV_CONTROVS.name: Company has operations located in biodiversity sensitive areas and is involved in controversies with severe impact on the environment
OPS_PROT_BIODIV_CONTROVS.description: Company reports having operations in or near to biodiversity sensitive areas and has been implicated in controversies with severe or very severe adverse impact on the environment

CARBON_EMISSIONS_SALES_EUR_SCOPE123_INTE.name: Total GHG Emissions Intensity per EUR million Sales (t/EUR million sales)
CARBON_EMISSIONS_SALES_EUR_SCOPE123_INTE.description: This factor indicates the most recent aggregate GHG emissions of the company (Scopes 1 and 2, and estimated Scope 3 emissions) relative to its most recent Sales in million Euro.

ALC_MAX_REV.name: Alcohol - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
ALC_MAX_REV.description: The recent-year percentage of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from manufacturing, distributing, retailing, licensing, and supplying alcoholic products.

PALM_TOTAL_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Palm Oil - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
PALM_TOTAL_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percentage of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from the production or distribution of Palm Oil.

AE_DIST_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Adult Entertainment Distributor - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
AE_DIST_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from distributing sexually explicit products and services, including X-rated movies and videos, printed materials, television programs, and online products.
AE_DIST_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

AE_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Adult Entertainment Producer - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
AE_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from producing, directing, or publishing adult entertainment materials that fall into the following categories: Producer of X-rated films, Producer of Pay-per-view programming or channels, Producer of sexually explicit video games, Producer of books or magazines with adult content, Live entertainment of an adul
AE_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

AE_RET_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Adult Entertainment Retailer - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
AE_RET_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from the retail sale of adult entertainment products through specialty stores or online sites.
AE_RET_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

AE_OWN_BY.name: Adult Entertainment - Ownership by an Adult Entertainment Company
AE_OWN_BY.description: Companies that are 50 percent or more owned by a company with involvement.
AE_OWN_BY.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

AE_OWN_OF.name: Adult Entertainment - Ownership of an Adult Entertainment Company
AE_OWN_OF.description: Companies that own 20 to 49.99 percent of a company with involvement. When a company owns 50 percent or more of a subsidiary with involvement, MSCI treats it as a consolidated subsidiary.
AE_OWN_OF.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

SRI_CRITERIA.name: Standard: Fails SRI Index Criteria
SRI_CRITERIA.description: Companies that fail Standard SRI Index Investment criteria in Alcohol, Civilian Firearms, Gambling, Weapons, Cluster Bombs, Landmines, Nuclear Power and Tobacco.
SRI_CRITERIA.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

TOB_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Tobacco Total - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
TOB_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from tobacco-related business activities.
TOB_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

GAM_OWN_BY.name: Gambling - Ownership by a Gambling Company
GAM_OWN_BY.description: Companies that are 50 percent or more owned by a company with involvement.
GAM_OWN_BY.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

GAM_OWN_OF.name: Gambling - Ownership of a Gambling Company
GAM_OWN_OF.description: Companies that own 20 to 49.99 percent of a company with involvement. When a company owns 50 percent or more of a subsidiary with involvement, MSCI treats it as a consolidated subsidiary.
GAM_OWN_OF.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

TOB_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Tobacco Producer - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
TOB_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from the manufacture of tobacco products.
TOB_PROD_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

TOB_OWN_BY.name: Tobacco Total - Ownership by a Tobacco Company
TOB_OWN_BY.description: Companies that are 50 percent or more owned by a company with involvement.
TOB_OWN_BY.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

TOB_OWN_OF.name: Tobacco Total - Ownership of a Tobacco Company
TOB_OWN_OF.description: Companies that own 20 to 49.99 percent of a company with involvement. When a company owns 50 percent or more of a subsidiary with involvement, MSCI treats it as a consolidated subsidiary.
TOB_OWN_OF.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

GAM_LICEN_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Gambling Licensor  - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
GAM_LICEN_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from licensing its company name or brand name to gambling products.
GAM_LICEN_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

GAM_SUPPOR_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Gambling Support - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
GAM_SUPPOR_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from providing key products or services fundamental to gambling operations, including: slot machines, roulette wheels, or lottery terminals; gambling technology and support such as IT maintenance, software design, security or surveillance systems, and lottery ticket printing; and, gambling-related services such
GAM_SUPPOR_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

GAM_OPER_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Gambling Operations - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
GAM_OPER_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from ownership or operation gambling facilities such as casinos, racetracks, bingo parlors, or other betting establishments, including: horse, dog, or other racing events that permit wagering; lottery operations; online gambling; pari-mutuel wagering facilities; bingo; pachislot and pachinko parlors; slot machi
GAM_OPER_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

CB_TIE.name: Cluster Munitions - Any Tie
CB_TIE.description: Companies with any industry tie to cluster munitions.
CB_TIE.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

LM_TIE.name: Landmines - Any Tie
LM_TIE.description: Companies that have any industry tie to the manufacture of landmines except for Safety, which is a positive indicator.
LM_TIE.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

THERMAL_COAL_RESERVES.name: Evidence of Thermal Coal Reserves
THERMAL_COAL_RESERVES.description: This field identifies companies that provide evidence of owning thermal coal including those that own less than 50% of a reserves field. Evidence of owning reserves includes companies providing the exact volume of reserves, and companies making a statement about their ownership of reserves. Thermal coal is used to fire power plants that produce steam for electricity and industrial uses.
THERMAL_COAL_RESERVES.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

THERMAL_COAL_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Thermal Coal - Maximum Percentage of Revenue
THERMAL_COAL_MAX_REV_PCT.description: This factor identifies the maximum percentage of revenue (either reported or estimated) greater than 0% that a company derives from the mining of thermal coal (including lignite, bituminous, anthracite and steam coal) and its sale to external parties. It excludes: revenue from metallurgical coal; coal mined for internal power generation (e.g. in the case of vertically integrated power producers);
THERMAL_COAL_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

WEAP_BIO_CHEM_MAX_REV_PCT.name: Weapons - Bio/chem Maximum Percentage of Revenue
WEAP_BIO_CHEM_MAX_REV_PCT.description: The recent-year percent of revenue, or maximum estimated percent, a company has derived from the manufacture of chemical or biological weapons and related systems or components.
WEAP_BIO_CHEM_MAX_REV_PCT.product: MSCI Business Involvement Screening Research – All Screens

CARBON_GOVERNMENT_CO2_INTENSITY_GDP_TONP.name: CO2 intensity (t/USD million GDP nominal)
CARBON_GOVERNMENT_CO2_INTENSITY_GDP_TONP.description: This data point represents CO2 intensity of an economy (in tons per USD million GDP nominal). The higher the value the more carbon intensive the economy is. It considers CO2 emission related to fossil fuel use and industrial processes (e.g. cement production etc.). (Sources: EDGAR, WDI).

CBN_LCT_CATEGORY.name: Low Carbon Transition Category
CBN_LCT_CATEGORY.description: This classification scheme assigns a Low Carbon Transition Category to a company based on its exposure to low carbon transition risks and opportunities. The category assignment is based on the size and nature of the company's current emissions profile and can be adjusted if the company's Low Carbon Transition Management Score is in the top or second quartile of its peer set. The categories are: As
CBN_LCT_CATEGORY.units: text (asset stranding, product transition, operational transition, neutral, solutions)

CBN_LCT_SCORE.name: Low Carbon Transition Score
CBN_LCT_SCORE.description: A company level score that measures a company’s level of alignment to the Low Carbon Transition. Companies with higher Low Carbon Transition score are more aligned with the Low Carbon Transition compared to the companies with lower scores. (Score: 0-10)

FOSSIL_FUEL_RESERVES.name: Fossil Fuel Reserves
FOSSIL_FUEL_RESERVES.description: This field identifies companies with evidence of owning fossil fuel reserves regardless of their industries, including companies that own less than 50% of a reserves field. Fossil reserves are defined as proved and probable reserves (i.e. 1P and 2P) for coal and proved reserves (i.e. 1P) for oil and natural gas. Evidence of owning reserves includes companies providing the exact volume of reserves,

OIL_GAS_ANY_TIE.name: Oil and Gas - Any Tie
OIL_GAS_ANY_TIE.description: Companies with an industry tie to oil and gas, in particular reserve ownership, oil and gas related revenues and power generation. It does not flag companies generating revenues from biofuels.

OIL_SANDS_RESERVES.name: Evidence of Oil Shale & Tar Sands Reserves
OIL_SANDS_RESERVES.description: This field identifies companies that provide evidence of owning oil sands reserves, including those that own less than 50% of a reserves field. Evidence of owning reserves includes companies providing the exact volume of reserves, and companies making a statement about their ownership of reserves.

SHALE_GAS_RESERVES.name: Evidence of Shale Gas Reserves
SHALE_GAS_RESERVES.description: This field identifies companies that provide evidence of owning shale gas reserves, including those that own less than 50% of a reserves field. Evidence of owning reserves includes companies providing the exact volume of reserves, and companies making a statement about their ownership of reserves.

THERMAL_COAL_INVOLVEMENT_ANYPCT.name: Thermal Coal - Involvement - 0%

FUND_ENVIRONMENT_CONTROVERSY_PCT.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value exposed to companies facing one or more Severe or Very Severe Environmental controversies related to Energy & Climate Change, Land Use & Biodiversity, Toxic Spills & Releases, Water Stress, or Operational Waste.

FUND_CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_M_NO.name: Fund "not determinable" company's three-year average carbon emissions intensity trend (%)

FUND_CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_M_ST.name: Fund "stable" company's three-year average carbon emissions intensity trend (%)
FUND_CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_M_ST.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value exposed to companies flagged as "Stable" if trend is stable at a rate between -5% and 5%. The full weight of each flagged company is included in the calculation.

FUND_CARBON_SCOPE_12_INTEN_3Y_TREND_M_WO.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value exposed to companies flagged as "Worsening" if the carbon emissions intensity trend is increasing at a rate 5% or worst. The full weight of each flagged company is included in the calculation.

FUND_BOARD_INDEP_0_25PCT.name: Fund Board Independence (0-25%)
FUND_BOARD_INDEP_0_25PCT.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value exposed to companies with <= 25% board independence.

FUND_HUMAN_CAPITAL_DEV_MGMT_SCORE.name: Fund Human Capital Development Management Score

FUND_LCT_CAT_OPERAT_TRANSITION_PCT.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value with a Low Carbon Transition Category of Operational Transition.

FUND_LCT_CAT_PRODUCT_TRANSITION_PCT.name: Fund Low Carbon Transition Category - Product Transition (%)
FUND_LCT_CAT_PRODUCT_TRANSITION_PCT.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value with a Low Carbon Transition Category of Product Transition.

FUND_LCT_CAT_SOLUTIONS_PCT.name: Fund Low Carbon Transition Category - Solutions (%)
FUND_LCT_CAT_SOLUTIONS_PCT.description: The percentage of portfolio's market value with a Low Carbon Transition Category of Solutions.

FUND_LOW_CARBON_TRANSITION.name: Fund Low Carbon Transition Score
FUND_LOW_CARBON_TRANSITION.description: The Fund Low Carbon Transition Score measures the alignment of underlying holdings to the Low Carbon Transition.

FUND_SFDR_VIOLATIONS_UNGC_OECD.name: Fund SFDR Violations of UN Global Compact principles and Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises (%)
FUND_SFDR_VIOLATIONS_UNGC_OECD.description: The percentage of the fund's market value exposed to issuers with severe or very severe controversies related to the company’s operations and/or products.

FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART6.name: Fund not sustainable under EU SFDR Article 6
FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART6.description: Flagged as (T) if a fund manager has deemed that sustainability risks, as defined by the EU SFDR, are not relevant to the investment process for this fund and are not integrated into investment or insurance advice.

FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART8.name: Fund policy - EU SFDR Article 8
FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART8.description: Flagged as (T) for funds that are classified under Article 8 of the EU SFDR by fund manager, i.e. the fund promotes, among other characteristics, environmental or social characteristics.

FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART9.name: Fund policy - EU SFDR Article 9
FP_REG_FRAME_SFDR_ART9.description: Flagged as (T) for funds that are classified under Article 9 of the EU SFDR by fund manager, i.e. the fund has sustainable investment as its objective.

FUND_SFDR_GHG_INTENSITY.name: Fund SFDR GHG Intensity of investee companies
FUND_SFDR_GHG_INTENSITY.description: The fund's weighted average of its holding issuers' GHG Intensity (Scope 1, Scope 2 and estimated Scope 3 GHG emissions/EUR million revenue).

FUND_SFDR_GHG_INTENSITY_COV.name: Fund SFDR GHG Intensity of investee companies coverage %
FUND_SFDR_GHG_INTENSITY_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers with carbon emissions (scope 1, 2, and 3) and revenue (EUR million) data.

FUND_SFDR_OPS_PROT_BIODIV_CONTROVS_COV.name: Fund SFDR Activities negatively affecting biodiversity-sensitive areas (%) coverage %
FUND_SFDR_OPS_PROT_BIODIV_CONTROVS_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers that MSCI has reviewed for SFDR activities negatively affecting biodiversity-sensitive areas.

FUND_SFDR_VIOLATIONS_UNGC_OECD_COV.name: Fund SFDR Violations of UN Global Compact principles and Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises (%) coverage %
FUND_SFDR_VIOLATIONS_UNGC_OECD_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers that MSCI has reviewed for SFDR violations of UN Global Compact principles and Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

FUND_SFDR_MECH_UN_GLOBAL_COMPACT_COV.name: Fund SFDR Lack of processes and compliance mechanisms to monitor compliance with UN Global Compact principles and OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises (%) coverage %
FUND_SFDR_MECH_UN_GLOBAL_COMPACT_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers that MSCI has reviewed for SFDR lack of processes and compliance mechanisms to monitor compliance with UN Global Compact principles and OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

FUND_SFDR_FEMALE_DIRECTORS_PCT.name: Fund SFDR Board Gender Diversity
FUND_SFDR_FEMALE_DIRECTORS_PCT.description: The fund holdings' weighted average of the percentage of board members who are female.

FUND_SFDR_PROD_CHEM.name: Fund SFDR Investments in companies producing chemicals (%)
FUND_SFDR_PROD_CHEM.description: The percentage of the fund’s market value exposed to issuers classified as manufacturers of pesticides and other agrochemical products by NACE Group (NACE Group Code 20.2).

FUND_SFDR_TRIR.name: Fund SFDR Rate of accidents
FUND_SFDR_TRIR.description: The total recordable incident rate (fatalities, lost time injuries, restricted work injuries and medical treatment injuries) associated with EUR 1 million invested in the fund. It is calculated as the weighted average of Total Recordable Incident Rate per company divided by the company’s most recently available enterprise value including cash (EVIC).

FUND_SFDR_TRIR_COV.name: Fund SFDR Rate of accidents coverage %
FUND_SFDR_TRIR_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers with a Total Recordable Incident Rate data.

FUND_SFDR_CONTR_DISCRIMINATION_DIV_N_SEV.name: Fund SFDR Incidents of discrimination (reported)
FUND_SFDR_CONTR_DISCRIMINATION_DIV_N_SEV.description: The total number of severe and very severe discrimination and diversity controversies associated with EUR 1 million invested in the fund. It is calculated as the weighted average of Number of Severe and Very Severe Discrimination and Diversity Controversies per company divided by the company’s most recently available enterprise value including cash (EVIC).
FUND_SFDR_CONTR_DISCRIMINATION_DIV_N_SEV.units: Very severe discrimination and diversity controversies per EUR 1 million invested (ratio)

FUND_SFDR_CONTR_DISCRIMINATION_DIV_N_SEV.name: Fund SFDR Incidents of discrimination (reported) coverage %
FUND_SFDR_CONTR_DISCRIMINATION_DIV_N_SEV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers with Number of Severe and Very Severe Discrimination and Diversity Controversies data.

FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN.name: Fund SFDR Lack of anti-corruption and anti-bribery policies (%)
FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN.description: The percentage of the fund's market value exposed to issuers without an anti-corruption and anti-bribery policy consistent with the United Nations Convention against Corruption.

FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN_COV.name: Fund SFDR Lack of anti-corruption and anti-bribery policies  coverage %
FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_POLICY_UN_COV.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers that MSCI has reviewed for SFDR lack of anti-corruption and anti-bribery policies.

FUND_FINANCED_CARBON_EMISSIONS.name: Fund Financed Scope 1+2 Carbon Emissions (Carbon Emissions / USD Million Invested)
FUND_FINANCED_CARBON_EMISSIONS.description: Represents a normalized measure of a fund's contribution to climate change that apportions companies’ Scope 1+2 carbon emissions across all outstanding shares and bonds. This figure measures the total annual Scope 1 and 2 carbon emissions (reported or estimated) associated with USD 1 million invested in the fund. It is calculated as the sum of companies’ Scope 1+2 carbon emissions weighted by the

FUND_FINANCED_CARBON_EMISSIONS_COVERAGE.name: Fund Financed Scope 1+2 Carbon Emissions Coverage (%)
FUND_FINANCED_CARBON_EMISSIONS_COVERAGE.description: The percentage of a portfolio's market value with Carbon Emissions - Scope 1+2 Intensity (t/USD million EVIC) data.

FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_CARBON_INTEN.name: Fund Weighted Average Scope 1+2 Carbon Intensity
FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_CARBON_INTEN.description: The Weighted Average Scope 1+2 Carbon Intensity measures a fund's exposure to carbon intensive companies . The figure is sum of security weight (normalized) multiplied by the security Scope 1+2 Carbon Intensity.

FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_CARBON_INTEN_COVERAGE.name: Fund Weighted Average Scope 1+2 Carbon Intensity Coverage (%)
FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_CARBON_INTEN_COVERAGE.description: The percentage of a portfolio's market value with Carbon Intensity data.

FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_SOV_CARBON_INTEN.name: Fund Weighted Average Sovereign Carbon Intensity (t/USD million GDP nominal)
FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_SOV_CARBON_INTEN.description: Weighted average of sovereign issuer’s carbon emissions generated by all economic activities performed domestically, per unit of GDP (USD million).

FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_SOV_CARBON_INTEN_COVER.name: Fund Weighted Average Sovereign Carbon Intensity Coverage (%)
FUND_WEIGHTED_AVG_SOV_CARBON_INTEN_COVER.description: The percentage of a portfolio's market value with GHG intensity data.

FUND_IMPLIED_TEMP_RISE.name: Fund Implied Temperature Rise
FUND_IMPLIED_TEMP_RISE.description: A fund’s Implied Temperature Rise measures, in aggregate, a fund’s temperature alignment (in °C) to keeping the world’s temperature rise to 2°C by 2100. The calculation uses an aggregated budget approach that compares the sum of financed emission budget overshoot against the sum of financed carbon emission budgets for the underlying portfolio holdings. FUND_IMPLIED_TEMP_RISE_COVERAGE.name: Fund Implied Temperature Rise Coverage
FUND_IMPLIED_TEMP_RISE_COVERAGE.description: The percentage of a fund’s market value invested in issuers with an Implied Temperature Rise (°C).

FUND_OIL_GAS_ANY_TIE.name: Fund Oil and Gas Involvement (%)
FUND_OIL_GAS_ANY_TIE.description: The percentage of fund's market value exposed to companies with an industry tie to oil and gas, in particular reserve ownership, oil and gas related revenues and power generation. It does not include companies generating revenues from biofuels.

FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_CONVICTIONS_COUNT.name: Fund SFDR Number of convictions for violation of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws
FUND_SFDR_CORR_BRIB_CONVICTIONS_COUNT.description: The sum of number of convictions against the fund’s holdings for violation of anti-corruption and anti-bribery laws.rruption and anti-bribery laws.

FUND_HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET.name: Fund SBTi approved Emission Target (%)
FUND_HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET.description: The percentage of the fund’s market value exposed to issuers that have carbon emissions reduction targets approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi).

FUND_HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET_COV.name: Fund SBTi approved Emission Target Coverage (%)
FUND_HAS_SBTI_APPROVED_TARGET_COV.description: The percentage of the fund's market value invested in issuers with SBTi approved Emission Target data.
